name: cwe-advisor-evals-js-superset
description: Superset dependency set for resolution-checking every JavaScript fixture (scripts/compilecheck.py). One install resolves the whole corpus; versions are current stable at authoring and pinned so checks are reproducible. Packages no fixture uses but a fix brings in (run 17) are included too, since the entries recommend them; native ones report unchecked because scripts are not run at install.
